(a) marine-like fossils are known from Miocene lacustrine deposits in the Ebro Basin of Spain; (b) these fossils lived in a lake with chemical parameters that are very similar to those of recent groundwaters with high Cl concentrations; and (c) the lake waters were probably affected by saline inflows.
